svg.aria-label: Left: two empirical CDFs with the KS statistic D drawn as the largest vertical gap. Right: for a fixed tiny shift of 0.02 standard deviations, D settles near 0.008 as samples grow, while the p-value becomes extremely small, so a p-value alert would fire on a meaningless shift
